motion: Universal Basic Income should be implemented

turns.argument_point:

According to research, implementing Universal Basic Income (UBI) requires careful consideration of administrative efficiency, including maintaining accurate records of eligible recipients, designing effective payment modalities, and establishing robust oversight mechanisms.
turns.rebuttal: While it is true that implementing Universal Basic Income (UBI) requires careful consideration of administrative efficiency, one must also acknowledge that the complexity of UBI's administrative framework may inadvertently create new inefficiencies and bureaucratic hurdles, potentially offsetting any potential gains in simplicity or cost-effectiveness.
